title: ‘Life, Larry, and the Pursuit of Unhappiness’ Is Pretty, Pretty Bad — and I Loved It
summary: Iconic curmudgeon Larry David celebrates our nation's 250th anniversary in an HBO sketch show that rehashes American history through his distinct lens.
